title: O‘zim, oilam va qarindoshlar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida qarindoshlar nomini aytasiz, egalik qo‘shimchalarini ishlatasiz, menda bor/yo‘q iborasini tuzasiz, oila hajmi va a’zolarning kasbini aytasiz.

scenes.title: Men va mening oilam
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! To‘rtinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan darsda raqamlarni, yoshni va telefon raqamini o‘rgandik. Bugun oilamiz haqida gaplashamiz: qarindoshlarning nomlari, “mening, sizning, uning” kabi egalik qo‘shimchalari, “menda bor” iborasi, oila a’zolari soni va kasblar. Dars oxirida to‘rt oila a’zosini olti gapda tasvirlay olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome to lesson four. Today we talk about family, possession and jobs.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Bugun oila, egalik va kasblar haqida gaplashamiz.

scenes.title: Yaqin oila
scenes.say_native: Yaqin oila a’zolari: ab — ota, umm — ona, akh — aka yoki uka, ukht — opa yoki singil, ibn — o‘g‘il, ibna — qiz. Muhim farq: o‘zbek tilida aka va uka, opa va singil alohida so‘zlar, arabchada esa yoshiga qarab ajratilmaydi: akh bitta so‘z, ukht bitta so‘z. Kerak bo‘lsa, “kabīr” — katta yoki “ṣaghīr” — kichik qo‘shamiz. “Umm” da shadda bor: m ikkilanadi.
scenes.say: Ab, umm, akh, ukht, ibn, ibna. Arabic does not separate older and younger siblings.
scenes.say_uz: Ab, umm, akh, ukht, ibn, ibna. Arabchada katta-kichik aka-ukani ajratmaydi.

scenes.title: Er, xotin va bobo-buvi
scenes.say_native: Yana oila a’zolari. Zawj — er, zawja — xotin. Jadd — bobo, jadda — buvi, ikkalasida shadda, d ikkilanadi. Wālidān — ota-ona, ya’ni ikkala ota-onaning bir so‘zi. E’tibor bering: ayol jinsidagi so‘zlar ko‘pincha ta marbuta, ya’ni “-a” bilan tugaydi: zawja, jadda, ibna. Bu jins belgisi, o‘tgan darslarda ko‘rgan edik. Erkak so‘zlariga “-a” qo‘shsangiz ayol shakli chiqadi.
scenes.say: Zawj is husband. Zawja is wife. Jadd is grandfather. Jadda is grandmother. Walidan means parents.
scenes.say_uz: Zavj er, zavja xotin. Jadd bobo, jadda buvi. Volidan ota-ona.

scenes.title: Amaki, tog‘a, amma, xola
scenes.say_native: Bu yerda o‘zbek tiliga o‘xshashlik bor. Arabchada ham otaning tomonidagi qarindoshlar onaning tomonidagi qarindoshlardan ajratiladi. ʿAmm — otaning aka-ukasi. Khāl — onaning aka-ukasi. ʿAmma — otaning opa-singlisi. Khāla — onaning opa-singlisi. O‘zbekchada ham amma, xola, tog‘a, amaki farqlanadi. Rus yoki ingliz tilida bu to‘rtta so‘z o‘rniga faqat “uncle” va “aunt” bor.
scenes.say: Amm is the father's brother. Khal is the mother's brother. Amma and khala are the aunts.
scenes.say_uz: Amm otaning akasi. Xal onaning akasi. Amma va xala xolalar.

scenes.title: Qarindoshni toping
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Beshta arabcha so‘zni o‘zbekchaga tarjima qiling: umm, jadda, khāl, ukht, zawj. Baland ovozda ayting. Har so‘zni ovozli aytib, shaddalarga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Translate: umm, jadda, khal, ukht, zawj.
scenes.say_uz: Tarjima qiling: umm, jadda, xal, ukht, zavj.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: umm — ona, jadda — buvi, khāl — tog‘a, ukht — opa yoki singil, zawj — er. Agar to‘rttasini topgan bo‘lsangiz, juda yaxshi. Endi “mening ota-onam” deyish uchun egalik qo‘shimchalarini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Mother, grandmother, maternal uncle, sister, husband.
scenes.say_uz: Ona, buvi, tog‘a, opa yoki singil, er.

scenes.title: Mening: -ī
scenes.say_native: Arabchada “mening” alohida so‘z emas, qo‘shimcha: oxirgi “-ī”. Umm — onam bo‘lib ummī bo‘ladi. Ukht — ukhtī. Bu o‘zbek tilidagi “-im” ga to‘g‘ri keladi: ona-m, opa-m. Muhim: “-ī” oldidan harf kasra oladi, shuning uchun “ummī”, “ukhtī”. Va “-ī” uzun unli, shuning uchun cho‘zing. Bu qo‘shimcha o‘zbekchadagidek so‘z oxiriga yopishadi.
scenes.say: My is the ending -i. Ummi is my mother. Ukhti is my sister.
scenes.say_uz: Mening -i qo‘shimchasi. Ummi onam. Uxti opam.

scenes.title: Sizning: -ka, -ki
scenes.say_native: “Sizning” uchun qo‘shimcha o‘tgan darsda ko‘rgan -ka va -ki. Kim bilan gaplashayotganingizga qarab tanlaymiz: erkakka -ka, ayolga -ki. Masalan, onangiz — ummuka erkakka, ummuki ayolga. O‘zbek tilida bu farq yo‘q, “onangiz” hammaga bir xil. Arabchada esa suhbatdoshning jinsi so‘zning oxiriga ta’sir qiladi. Birinchi unli esa damma bo‘ladi: ummuka.
scenes.say: Your is -ka for a man and -ki for a woman. Ummuka. Ummuki.
scenes.say_uz: Sizning -ka erkakka, -ki ayolga. Ummuka. Ummuki.

scenes.title: Uning: -hu, -hā
scenes.say_native: “Uning” uchun ikkita qo‘shimcha bor. Egasi erkak bo‘lsa -hu, ayol bo‘lsa -hā. Ummuhu — uning, ya’ni erkakning onasi. Ummuhā — ayolning onasi. Ingliz tilida ham “his mother” va “her mother” farqlanadi, o‘zbek tilida esa “uning onasi” hammaga bir xil. Shu sabab arabchada kim haqida gapirayotganingizni bilishingiz kerak. Egasi aniq bo‘lsa, ichki hisobni to‘g‘ri yuriting.
scenes.say: His is -hu. Her is -ha. It depends on the owner, not on the thing.
scenes.say_uz: Uning erkak bo‘lsa -hu, ayol bo‘lsa -ha. Egasining jinsiga bog‘liq.

scenes.title: Ota va aka: maxsus shakllar
scenes.say_native: Ikkita so‘z biroz boshqacha: ab — ota va akh — aka. “Mening” bilan oddiy: abī, akhī. Lekin -ka, -hu, -hā bilan uzun “ū” chiqadi: abūka, abūhu, abūhā, akhūka, akhūhu, akhūhā. Bu istisno, shunchaki yodlab oling. Ona so‘zi esa muntazam: ummuka, ummuhu. Shuning uchun “sizning otangiz” abūka, “sizning onangiz” ummuka. Bu ikki so‘zni mashq qilsangiz, qolganlari oson.
scenes.say: Ab and akh are irregular: abuka, abuhu, abuha. Umm is regular.
scenes.say_uz: Ab va akh istisno: abuka, abuhu, abuha. Umm muntazam.

scenes.title: Uning: erkak va ayol
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p xato: “uning” ni adashtirish. O‘zbek tilida “uning onasi” jinsga qaramaydi, shuning uchun arabchada ham bir xil aytishga moyilsiz. Aslida Karim haqida “ummuhu”, Maryam haqida “ummuhā”. Birinchi savol: kim haqida gapiryapman, erkak yoki ayol? Ikkinchi xato: egalik qo‘shimchasi bilan “al” artiklini ishlatish: “al-ummī” noto‘g‘ri. To‘g‘risi “ummī”.
scenes.say: Choose hu for a male owner and ha for a female owner. Do not add al.
scenes.say_uz: Erkak egasi uchun hu, ayol uchun ha. Al qo‘shmang.

scenes.title: Tarjima qiling
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta ibora. Birinchi: mening ukam. Ikkinchi: ayolga murojaat qilib, sizning opangiz. Uchinchi: Karimning onasi. To‘rtinchi: Maryamning otasi. Baland ovozda arabcha ayting. Ota so‘zining maxsus shaklini unutmang.
scenes.say: My brother. Your sister to a woman. His mother. Her father.
scenes.say_uz: Mening akam. Ayolga: sizning opangiz. Uning onasi. Uning otasi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: akhī — mening akam yoki ukam. Ukhtuki — sizning opangiz, ayolga. Ummuhu — Karimning onasi. Abūhā — Maryamning otasi. Hammasini to‘g‘ri aytgan bo‘lsangiz, egalik qo‘shimchalarini egalladingiz. Endi “menda bor” iborasini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Akhi. Ukhtuki. Ummuhu. Abuha.
scenes.say_uz: Axi. Uxtuki. Ummuhu. Abuha.

scenes.title: Menda bor: ʿindī
board: عِنْدِي أَخ (ʿindī akh) — menda aka/uka bor
scenes.say_native: Arab tilida “bor” fe’li kabi “have” fe’li yo‘q. “Menda bor” uchun “ʿinda” predlogi ishlatiladi: ʿindī akh, so‘zma-so‘z “mening yonimda aka”. Bu aynan o‘zbekcha “menda aka bor” ga o‘xshaydi, faqat “bor” so‘zi aytilmaydi. “Sizda” — ʿindaka erkakka, ʿindaki ayolga; “unda” — ʿindahu, ʿindahā. Shundan keyin kimda nima borligini aytasiz.
scenes.say: Indi akh means I have a brother. There is no verb to have; we use inda.
scenes.say_uz: Indi akh menda aka bor. Have fe’li yo‘q, inda ishlatiladi.

scenes.title: Savol va inkor
scenes.say_native: Savol uchun gap boshiga “hal” qo‘yiladi: hal ʿindaka akh? — sizda aka bormi? Javob: “naʿam, ʿindī akh” yoki “lā, laysa ʿindī akh”. Inkor uchun “laysa” ishlatiladi, ya’ni “emas, yo‘q”. “Hal” so‘rog‘i ovoz ohangini o‘zgartirishni talab qilmaydi, o‘zbekdagi “-mi” qo‘shimchasiga o‘xshaydi, faqat boshida turadi. Shunday qilib, savol berish juda oson.
scenes.say: Hal makes a yes or no question. Laysa makes it negative.
scenes.say_uz: Hal ha yoki yo‘q savol yasaydi. Laysa inkor yasaydi.

scenes.title: Menda yo‘q: noto‘g‘ri inkor
scenes.say_native: Ikkita xato. Birinchisi: “lā ʿindī akh” — o‘zbekcha “menda aka yo‘q” ning to‘g‘ridan to‘g‘ri tarjimasi. Adabiy tilda to‘g‘ri shakl “laysa ʿindī akh”. Lahjalarda “mā ʿindī” deydilar, lekin biz adabiy arab tilini o‘rganamiz. Ikkinchisi: “aka bor” ni “amlik”, ya’ni “egalik qilaman” deb aytish. Bu aka egasi bo‘lishni anglatib, g‘alati eshitiladi. Odamlar uchun “ʿindī” ishlating.
scenes.say: Do not say la indi. Say laysa indi. Do not use amliku for relatives.
scenes.say_uz: La indi demang. Laysa indi deng. Qarindosh uchun amliku ishlatmang.

scenes.title: Bor yoki yo‘q
board: 1) Menda ikkita opa bor... (bitta so‘z: opa)
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uch gap. Birinchi: menda opa bor, bitta opa. Ikkinchi: erkakka murojaat qilib, sizda aka bormi? Uchinchi: menda aka yo‘q. Baland ovozda arabcha ayting.
scenes.say: I have a sister. Do you have a brother, to a man? I do not have a brother.
scenes.say_uz: Menda opa bor. Sizda aka bormi? Menda aka yo‘q.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: ʿindī ukht. Hal ʿindaka akh? Laysa ʿindī akh. Savolda erkakka -ka, ayolga -ki ekanini yana eslang. Agar jumlani to‘g‘ri tuzgan bo‘lsangiz, ikkita muhim tuzilmani egalladingiz: egalik va so‘roq. Endi dialogni tinglaymiz.
scenes.say: Indi ukht. Hal indaka akh? Laysa indi akh.
scenes.say_uz: Indi ukht. Hal indaka ax? Laysa indi ax.

scenes.title: Birinchi dialog: oilangiz haqida
board: وَلِيد: هَلْ عِنْدَكِ إِخْوَة يَا سَلْمَى؟
سَلْمَى: نَعَم، عِنْدِي أَخ وَأُخْتَان. وَأَنْتَ؟
وَلِيد: لَيْسَ عِنْدِي إِخْوَة. أَنَا وَحِيد.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog. Valid Salmodan aka-ukalari bor-yo‘qligini so‘raydi. Salma bitta aka va ikkita opa borligini aytadi. Valid esa aka-ukasi yo‘qligini va u yagona farzand ekanini aytadi. Oxirida Salma mehr bilan javob beradi. Raqamlar va “hal ʿindaki” ga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Do you have siblings, Salma? Yes, I have a brother and two sisters. And you? I have none. I am an only child. Welcome to our family.
scenes.say_uz: Aka-uka, opa-singillaringiz bormi, Salma? Ha, bitta akam va ikkita opam bor. O‘zingizda-chi? Yo‘q. Men yagonaman. Oilamizga xush kelibsiz.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: Salmada qancha aka-uka, opa-singil bor? Ikkinchi: Validning aka-ukasi bormi? Uchinchi: Valid o‘zini nima deb atadi, “waḥīd” so‘zining ma’nosi nima? Javob bering.
scenes.say: How many siblings does Salma have? Does Walid? What does wahid mean here?
scenes.say_uz: Salmada nechta aka-uka bor? Validda bormi? Vahid nima degani?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: Salmada bitta aka va ikkita opa, jami uchta. Validda aka-uka yo‘q. “Waḥīd” — yagona, yolg‘iz. Bu so‘z “wāḥid” — bir bilan bir ildizdan. Siz buni keyingi darslarda ildiz tizimi bilan ko‘proq o‘rganasiz. Hozircha so‘zni eslab qoling.
scenes.say: One brother and two sisters, three in total. Walid has none. Wahid means only.
scenes.say_uz: Bitta aka va ikkita opa, jami uchta. Validda yo‘q. Vahid yagona degani.

scenes.title: Ikkita va ko‘p: -ān va ko‘plik
board: اِبْن: اِبْنَان، أَبْنَاء   بِنْت: بِنْتَان، بَنَات
scenes.say_native: Arabchada uchta son turi bor: bitta, ikkita va ko‘p. Ikkitalik uchun maxsus qo‘shimcha: “-ān”. Akh — akhawān, ukht — ukhtān. Ikkitadan ko‘p uchun alohida ko‘plik: ikhwa — aka-ukalar, akhawāt — opa-singillar. Bu so‘z tubidan o‘zgaradi. O‘zbekcha “ikki ta aka” deymiz, arabchada esa “ikki” demaymiz, faqat -ān qo‘shamiz. Shuning uchun “ithnān akhawān” noto‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: Two uses -an. Three or more uses a separate plural: ikhwa and akhawat.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkita -an bilan. Uchtadan ko‘pi alohida ko‘plik: ixva, axavat.

scenes.title: Oila a’zolari soni
scenes.say_native: Oilangiz hajmini aytish uchun: “kam fardan fī ʿā’ilatika?” — oilangizda necha kishi bor? Javob: “fī ʿā’ilatī khamsat afrād” — oilamda besh kishi bor. “Fard” — shaxs, “afrād” — shaxslar. Tavsif uchun: “ʿā’ilatī kabīra” — oilam katta, “ʿā’ilatī ṣaghīra” — oilam kichik. Sifat so‘zning jinsiga moslashadi: ʿā’ila ayol jinsli, shuning uchun kabīra, ta marbuta bilan.
scenes.say: Kam fardan fi a'ilatika? In my family there are five people. My family is big.
scenes.say_uz: Oilangizda necha kishi bor? Oilamda besh kishi bor. Oilam katta.

scenes.title: Ikkitalik shakli
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: ikkitani “ithnān akh”, “ikki aka” deb aytish. Arabchada ikkitalik shaklining o‘zi bor: akhawān. Ikkinchi xato: sifatning jinsini moslamaslik. Oila — ayol jinsli so‘z, shuning uchun “kabīra” va “ṣaghīra”. O‘zbek tilida sifat o‘zgarmaydi, arabchada esa o‘zgaradi. Ko‘z o‘ngingizda ta marbuta, ya’ni “-a” bo‘lsa, sifat ham “-a” bilan tugaydi.
scenes.say: Two brothers is akhawan. Family is feminine, so kabira.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkita aka akhavan. Oila ayol jinsli, shuning uchun kabira.

scenes.title: Oila a’zolari
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta gapni arabcha ayting. Birinchi: menda ikkita opa bor. Ikkinchi: oilamda to‘rt kishi bor. Uchinchi: oilam kichik. Ikkitalik shaklini va sifat jinsini unutmang.
scenes.say: I have two sisters. There are four people in my family. My family is small.
scenes.say_uz: Menda ikkita opa bor. Oilamda to‘rt kishi bor. Oilam kichik.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: ʿindī ukhtān. Fī ʿā’ilatī arbaʿat afrād. ʿĀ’ilatī ṣaghīra. Uchala gapni to‘g‘ri aytgan bo‘lsangiz, ikkitalik va sifat jinsini yaxshi egalladingiz. Endi kasblarga o‘tamiz.
scenes.say: Indi ukhtan. Fi a'ilati arbaat afrad. A'ilati saghira.
scenes.say_uz: Indi uxtan. Fi oilati arbaʿat afrad. Oilati sag‘ira.

scenes.title: Kasblar: erkak va ayol
scenes.say_native: Kasb nomlari ham jinsga ega. Erkak uchun oddiy shakl: muhandis, ṭabīb, muʿallim. Ayol uchun oxiriga ta marbuta qo‘shiladi: muhandisa, ṭabība, muʿallima. O‘zbek tilida “o‘qituvchi” erkagu ayolga bir xil. Arabchada esa onam muʿallima, otam muʿallim. Yana bir muhim narsa: talaba — ṭālib erkak, ṭāliba ayol. Hamshira muʿallima kabi mumarriḍ va mumarriḍa.
scenes.say: Jobs have a masculine and a feminine form. Add -a for a woman.
scenes.say_uz: Kasblarning erkak va ayol shakli bor. Ayolga -a qo‘shiladi.

scenes.title: Kasb so‘rash va aytish
scenes.say_native: Kasbni so‘rash: “mādhā yaʿmalu abūka?” — otangiz nima ish qiladi? Ona uchun fe’l o‘zgaradi: “mādhā taʿmalu ummuka?” Javob oddiy: “abī muhandis”, so‘zma-so‘z “otam muhandis”. Bu yerda ham “bo‘lmoq” fe’li yo‘q. Muhim: kasb so‘zi artiklsiz keladi: muhandis, al-muhandis emas. Ingliz tilidagidek “a” ham kerak emas. “Hu” — u (erkak), “hiya” — u (ayol): hiya muʿallima.
scenes.say: Madha yamalu abuka? What does your father do? Abi muhandis. My father is an engineer.
scenes.say_uz: Otangiz nima ish qiladi? Otam muhandis.

scenes.title: Kasbning jinsi
scenes.say_native: Xato: onam haqida erkak shakldagi kasb nomini ishlatish. O‘zbek tilida “onam shifokor” deymiz, arabchada esa “ummī ṭabība”. Ayol jinsida kasb so‘zi ta marbuta bilan tugashi kerak. Ikkinchi xato: artikl qo‘shish: “abī al-muhandis” desangiz, gap tugallanmagandek eshitiladi, chunki bu butun ibora, ya’ni “mening ota-muhandis”. Gapda kasb so‘zi artiklsiz bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: A woman takes the feminine form. Do not add al to the job in a simple sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Ayol ayol shaklini oladi. Oddiy gapda kasbga al qo‘shmang.

scenes.title: Kasblarni ayting
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta gapni arabcha ayting. Birinchi: otam shifokor. Ikkinchi: onam o‘qituvchi. Uchinchi: opam muhandis. To‘rtinchi: akam talaba. Har gapda kasbning jinsini tekshiring.
scenes.say: My father is a doctor. My mother is a teacher. My sister is an engineer. My brother is a student.
scenes.say_uz: Otam shifokor. Onam o‘qituvchi. Opam muhandis. Akam talaba.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: abī ṭabīb. Ummī muʿallima. Ukhtī muhandisa. Akhī ṭālib. Agar onam va opam haqidagi kasb nomlarida ta marbuta qo‘shgan bo‘lsangiz, jinsni to‘g‘ri tanladingiz. Endi bir dialogni tinglaymiz.
scenes.say: Abi tabib. Ummi mu'allima. Ukhti muhandisa. Akhi talib.
scenes.say_uz: Abi tabib. Ummi muallima. Uxti muhandisa. Axi talib.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi dialog: oila va kasblar
board: كَرِيم: مَاذَا يَعْمَلُ أَبُوكِ يَا مَرْيَم؟
مَرْيَم: أَخِي طَالِب. عِنْدِي أُخْت أَيْضًا، هِيَ مُهَنْدِسَة.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Karim Maryamdan oilasi haqida so‘raydi. Maryam otasi o‘qituvchi, onasi shifokor ekanini aytadi. Karim akasi haqida so‘raydi. Maryam akasi talaba ekanini va yana bir opasi borligini, opa muhandis ekanini aytadi. Kasblarning jinsiga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: What does your father do, Maryam? My father is a teacher and my mother is a doctor. And your brother? He is a student. I also have a sister, she is an engineer.
scenes.say_uz: Otangiz nima ish qiladi, Maryam? Otam o‘qituvchi, onam shifokor. Akangiz-chi? Akam talaba. Opam ham bor, u muhandis.

scenes.title: Savollar
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Maryamning otasi qanday kasbda? Onasi? Akasi? Opasi? Javoblarni eslab, arabcha yoki o‘zbekcha ayting.
scenes.say: What is Maryam's father's job? Her mother's? Her brother's? Her sister's?
scenes.say_uz: Maryamning otasi kim? Onasi? Akasi? Opasi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: otasi muʿallim — o‘qituvchi, onasi ṭabība — shifokor, akasi ṭālib — talaba, opasi muhandisa — muhandis. Hind opasi haqida “hiya muhandisa” dedi. Bu yerda “hiya” ayol uchun “u”. Muvaffaqiyat: kasb jinslarini ajratdingiz.
scenes.say: Teacher, doctor, student, engineer.
scenes.say_uz: O‘qituvchi, shifokor, talaba, muhandis.

scenes.title: Kimnidir tanishtirish: hādhā, hādhihi
scenes.say_native: Oila a’zosini tanishtirish uchun “bu” so‘zi kerak. Erkak uchun “hādhā”, ayol uchun “hādhihi”. Hādhā akhī Karīm — bu akam Karim. Hādhihi ukhtī Salmā — bu opam Salma. Bu yerda ham “bo‘lmoq” fe’li yo‘q. Rasm ko‘rsatib, oilangizni shunday tanishtirishingiz mumkin. O‘zbek tilida “bu” hammaga bir xil, arabchada esa jinsga qarab tanlaymiz.
scenes.say: This is my brother Karim. This is my sister Salma.
scenes.say_uz: Bu akam Karim. Bu opam Salma.

scenes.title: O‘zingiz haqingizda
scenes.say_native: O‘zingiz haqingizda ham aytishingiz mumkin. Ana ṭālib — men talabaman, erkak; ana ṭāliba — ayol. Oilaviy holat: mutazawwij — uylangan, mutazawwija — turmush qurgan. Bo‘ydoq erkak — aʿzab, bo‘ydoq ayol — ʿazbā’. Bu savollarni ba’zan odobsiz deb hisoblash mumkin, shuning uchun faqat o‘zingiz haqida gapirganda yoki yaqin odam bilan ishlating.
scenes.say: Ana talib means I am a student. Mutazawwij means married.
scenes.say_uz: Ana talib men talabaman. Mutazavvij uylangan.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: shadda va uzun unli
scenes.say_native: Oilaviy so‘zlarda ikki xususiyat takrorlanadi. Birinchisi: shadda. Umm, jadd, ʿamm, ʿamma, jadda so‘zlarida undosh ikkilanadi, uni qisqa to‘xtashdek aytmang, balki cho‘zing: um-m. Ikkinchisi: uzun unli. Khāl, abūka, akhūhā so‘zlarida uzun unli ikki barobar cho‘ziladi. Uzunlikni yo‘qotsangiz “ʿamm” va “ʿamma” aralashib ketadi. Ovozingizni yozib, tinglab ko‘ring.
scenes.say: Double the consonant in umm and jadd. Hold the long vowels.
scenes.say_uz: Umm va jaddda undoshni ikkilang. Uzun unlilarni cho‘zing.

scenes.title: Namuna: oilam haqida
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna. “ʿā’ilatī kabīra. Abī muʿallim, wa ummī ṭabība. ʿIndī akh wa ukhtān. Akhī ṭālib, wa ukhtī muhandisa.” Bu yerda oila, ota-ona, aka-ukalar va ularning kasbi bor. Siz ham shunday tuzing: olti gap, to‘rt oila a’zosi. Har bir gapda egalik qo‘shimchasi, ya’ni -ī, bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: My family is big. My father is a teacher and my mother is a doctor. I have a brother and two sisters.
scenes.say_uz: Oilam katta. Otam o‘qituvchi, onam shifokor. Menda aka va ikkita opa bor.

scenes.title: To‘rt a’zo, olti gap
scenes.say_native: Endi sizning navbatingiz. To‘rt oila a’zosini olti gapda tasvirlang. Masalan, oilangiz hajmi, otangiz va onangizning kasbi, aka-uka yoki opa-singillaringiz soni, bittasining yoshi. Jins qo‘shimchalariga e’tibor bering. Sekin va aniq gapiring.
scenes.say: Describe four family members in six sentences.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt oila a’zosini olti gapda tasvirlang.

scenes.title: O‘z-o‘zini tekshirish
scenes.say_native: Tekshiring. Birinchi: har gapda -ī, -ka yoki -hā, to‘g‘ri qo‘shimcha bormi? Ikkinchi: ayol a’zolar kasbi ta marbuta bilan tugadimi? Uchinchi: ikkita aka yoki opa bo‘lsa ikkitalik shaklini ishlatdingizmi? To‘rtinchi: jami olti gap aytdingizmi? Hammasiga “ha” desangiz, vazifa bajarildi.
scenes.say: Check possessives, feminine job forms and dual forms.
scenes.say_uz: Egalik, ayol kasbi va ikkitalik shakllarini tekshiring.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: أَب، أُمّ، أَخ، أُخْت، عَمّ، خَال
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Qarindosh nomlarini o‘rgandik. Egalik qo‘shimchalari: -ī, -ka, -ki, -hu, -hā. Ota va aka so‘zlari istisno: abūka, akhūhu. Egalikni “ʿindī” bilan ifodaladik, inkor uchun “laysa”, savol uchun “hal”. Ikkitalik -ān. Oila hajmi uchun afrād. Kasblarda ayolga ta marbuta qo‘shiladi. Eng muhim fikr: arabchada jins hamma joyda ko‘rinadi.
scenes.say: We learned family words, possession, dual forms and jobs.
scenes.say_uz: Oila so‘zlari, egalik, ikkitalik va kasblarni o‘rgandik.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi. To‘rt oila a’zongizni olti gapda arabcha tasvirlang va ovozingizni yozing yoki yozib qo‘ying. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida olti gap, to‘g‘ri egalik qo‘shimchalari va ayol kasblari. Keyingi darsda “bo‘lmoq” fe’li va eng oddiy gaplarni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Homework: describe four family members in six sentences.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: to‘rt oila a’zosini olti gapda tasvirlang.

homework_uz: To‘rt oila a’zongizni olti gapda arabcha tasvirlang va ovozingizni yozib oling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida olti gap, to‘g‘ri egalik qo‘shimchalari va ayol kasblari.
